storyCards.headline: Hotline Bling: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Drake's "Hotline Bling" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Hotline Bling" is a song recorded by Canadian rapper Drake, which served as the lead single from his fourth studio album Views (2016).

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 36 weeks on the chart.

Hotline Bling was released in 2015.
